evidence.quote: No design number was read before `lna/ref/check_hb.py` printed **GREEN**. Four checks, all closed-form, no BSIM anywhere
Golden-locked: `extract.py --selftest` reads **3.012469 dB vs the analytic 3.0103**, and `ref/check_nf.py` is GREEN across an Rn sweep (worst error 0.002 dB).
the honest headline of this stage is *156 rows and a validated instrument*, not a result.

rule: Validate every new harness against closed form and print GREEN before reading a single design number from it.

applicability.applies: Every measurement capability added to this tree; the regression quartet (now check_ref/check_nf/check_stab/check_bjt/check_op/check_hb/check_iip3/check_diff) is required green before AND after every work package.
applicability.not: A golden certifies the arithmetic, not the claim -- see must-fail-control-in-every-golden for the numerics and cross-simulator-port-must-be-measured for the model. A golden built only on a purely resistive reference silently exempts the integrator.
